filer_name.rationale: No canonical element exists for the filer's name in this schedule's XSD; it is a header field inherited from the parent return, not a discrete element in IRS5471ScheduleH.

filer_identifying_number.rationale: The filer's identifying number (SSN/ITIN/EIN from page 1 header) is not a discrete element in IRS5471ScheduleH; candidates 11, 34 refer to the foreign corporation's EIN/SSN, and 19/31 to missing-EIN reason codes, none of which represent the filer's TIN.

tax_year_begin.rationale: No candidate element exists in IRS5471ScheduleH for the annual accounting period begin date; this is a header-level attribute not exposed as a leaf element in this schedule's XSD.

tax_year_end.rationale: No candidate element exists in IRS5471ScheduleH for the annual accounting period end date; same structural mismatch as tax_year_begin.

current_ep_functional_currency.rationale: CurrentEarningsAndProfitsAmt maps directly to Schedule H line 1 — current year E&P in functional currency.

ep_reduction_taxes.rationale: TaxesNetAddnAmt (or SbtrctnAmt) relates to tax adjustments; however the schema splits taxes into addition/subtraction variants — TaxesNetSbtrctnAmt (idx 36) best represents line 2a reduction for taxes paid/accrued, but blueprint description says 'reduction' which is a subtraction, so idx 36 is the closer match.

ep_reduction_blocked_earnings.rationale: No candidate element corresponds to a specific reduction for blocked/deferral earnings (Schedule H line 2b); this field has no matching leaf in the canonical XSD candidate list.

ep_reduction_other.rationale: OtherAdjustmentsNetAddnAmt/SbtrctnAmt relate to general other adjustments in the reconciliation, not specifically to the line 2c 'other reductions' reduction line; cannot confidently match without a dedicated element.

current_ep_us_dollars.rationale: CurrEarnAndPrftInUSDollarsAmt directly represents current year earnings and profits translated to U.S. dollars, matching the blueprint description.
